subject: Spec: Scorecard per-question answer explanation (design spec, deferred)
body:
## Problem
Scorecard currently shows per-standard aggregates (X/Y correct per standard). Kai can see he got 2/5 on W2.b but can't see which specific questions he missed or what the right answers were. After exam submission, Kai has no way to study his mistakes.

## Proposal: Post-Exam Review Mode

After scorecard Stage 1 (score/grade/coach), Stage 2 now has two sections:

### Section A: Per-Standard Summary (existing)
X/Y correct per standard -- keep as-is.

### Section B: Review My Missed Questions (new)
'Review Missed' accordion -- lists questions Kai answered wrong.

For each missed question:
- Question text (from the exam)
- Kai's answer (highlighted in red, crossed out)
- Correct answer (highlighted in green)
- feedback_wrong text from the JSON (reused -- already written by GR)

Anatomy:
```
┌──────────────────────────────────────────┐
│  Q3: What is the vertex form of...       │
│  Your answer: y = 2(x+3)^2 - 1 ✗       │
│  Correct: y = 2(x-3)^2 - 1 ✓            │
│  Vertex gives h,k. Plug in point...      │
└──────────────────────────────────────────┘
```

## Priority: LOW (deferred)
This is a significant feature addition. Not filing as a GA spec yet.

Blocking questions before spec goes live:
1. Is there concern about Kai memorizing answers if he sees them post-exam? (Marcus/GR input needed)
2. Do we want to show ALL questions or just missed ones?
3. Does this affect the localStorage score storage format?

Filing this as a design idea only. Not actionable until blocking questions resolved.

## For Marcus at Next 1:1
Post-exam review mode: does Marcus want Kai to be able to see his wrong answers after submission? This shapes the feature scope significantly.

## Priority: LOW / DEFERRED

## Related
- sw-13: Answer explanation field in scorecard
- data/*.json: feedback_wrong field (already present on all questions)
